adoptionRule: Values are fixed before implementation and are not read from implementation code, route tables, classifiers or the system under test. Entries may change only together with design.md before the phase contract is adopted; after adoption every value is immutable.

stub.requestLog: GET /_stub/requests returns {requests:[raw chat-completion bodies]}; POST /_stub/requests resets it
stub.modelMatchRule: A logged request matches model M when body.model equals M or equals '<providerId>/' + M. Bare model ids are unique across providers in this fixture, so the match is unambiguous.
stub.replyTextRule: reply text is 'uar-sys-reply-' + bare model id

negativeControl.directRoute: POST /api/uar/providers/sysp3/default with sysp3 disabled, store healthy
negativeControl.stateAfter: default pair unchanged in the registry and in the store
negativeControl.rejectsWhichWrongImplementation: a route without the disabled-provider check (the pre-phase baseline accepts it with 200 and swaps the live default, src/uar/api/providers.rs set_default checks existence only)
negativeControl.whyNotBaselineForPartsAB: the pre-phase route already persists before swapping (providers.rs set_default) and the baseline console rolls the optimistic default back (frontend/src/lib/realtime/optimistic.ts), so the baseline passes parts A and B and cannot discriminate there; those parts are failed by a console that shows the pair as live after the failure, calls the default route after a failed save, or an implementation that swaps the registry before persisting

samples.stoppingRule: fixed N=3, every sample must pass

catalogScale.derivedBy: counted from the committed catalog snapshot only (provider id + '/' + model id, case-insensitive substring); no frontend or server output used
catalogScale.searchRule: case-insensitive substring over provider_id + '/' + model_id; for the chosen query the count is identical over the bare model id and over the display name
catalogScale.optionsPresentedUnfiltered: at least 8170 (catalog pairs plus configured custom models); not asserted exactly
catalogScale.unusableRows: rows of providers that are not configured and enabled, or models absent from the provider's models, are listed but not selectable; selecting one stores nothing

negativeControl.worktree: scripts/worktree-new.sh sys-baseline --base f2c9e36efe088e06a17c5d880ada877e25f2ad52 (path ~/.claude/worktrees/sys-baseline), removed afterwards with scripts/worktree-rm.sh
negativeControl.surface: /admin/models (Models page, full-catalog list), same frozen query
negativeControl.expectedRejection: the same measurement reports more than 200 rendered rows or a long task above 200 ms; if the baseline passes both, the scenario is BLOCKED because it cannot discriminate

samples.stoppingRule: fixed N, every sample must pass (candidate) / every sample must show the rejection (control)
